## Book

The Veil of the Square Mile — analytical history of the City of London Corporation and durable financial power. Print ISBN 979-8-2561-9387-4. 6x9, 384 pages, paperback.

The Companion Guide is the map: sources, timelines, dynastic trees, glossary, bibliography. Hardcover companion on presale.

Presale through 26 August 2026. Digital formats follow that date. Print ships after local / POD fulfillment.

## Do not confuse

- This is not a local service business.
- This is not dark romance publishing.
- Primary entities: City of London Corporation, Square Mile, Court of Common Council, Lord Mayor.
